beats.event: Six-year-old Scout lives with brother Jem and father Atticus
Befriends the visiting boy Dill each summer
Fascinated and afraid of reclusive neighbor Boo Radley
Small gifts appear for her and Jem in the Radleys' tree
Other children taunt them for Atticus defending Tom
Tempted to fight to defend her father's honor
At the jail she shames the lynch mob into breaking up
Rev. Sykes takes the children up to watch Tom's trial
Jem's faith in justice is shattered by the guilty verdict
Ewell attacks her and Jem walking home from the pageant
Realizes the man carrying wounded Jem home is Boo Radley
Walks Boo back to his porch
Standing on Boo's porch, imagines the world from his side
